notes.title: Gamescom 2024
notes.content:
Find us at Gamescom!

GraveyardGambit will be showcased at a booth on two days during Gamescom. Here, you can test the game and chat with the developers Emelie Dahlmeyer and Malte Lehmann.

Where can you find us?

Hall 10.2 - E20/D22 at the GameUp! Rheinland-Pfalz joint booth.

When can you find us?


 Wednesday, 21st August, from 12 PM to 2 PM
 Saturday, 24th August, from 5 PM to 7 PM


We look forward to seeing you!

notes.title: New Achievements
notes.content:
New Update:

There are 3 new achievements:


 1. Reach Raid 100
 2. Collect 3 experience points in a single raid
 3. Watch a fireworks display from a bench


Additional Changes:

To make the game more challenging in later rounds, 2 new guards have been added in rounds 60 and 80.  
The maximum number of players listed on the leaderboard has been increased to 50.

Hotfixes:


 Fixed an issue where a wall would become invisible.
 Fixed an issue where some names on the leaderboard were unreadable.

notes.title: Leaderboard Steam Global and Friends
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45103258/5fbe5d881bfca46c27a5c66a90eec4c2bfd2f073.png

Starting today, you can compete with your friends in GraveyardGambit. The best of the best will even be shown in the Top 25 on the Global Leaderboard.

Specific Updates:


 Each time you increase your high score, it is automatically entered into the leaderboard.
 In the "Leaderboard" tab, you can see the Top 25 players globally.
 In the "Leaderboard" tab, you can see the Top 25 players on your friends list.
 You can switch between the global and friends leaderboard by selecting the "Friends" or "Global" buttons.
 If you delete all data via "Restart" - "Delete All", your leaderboard entry will also be reset.


Note: Your leaderboard entry can only be updated a maximum of 10 times within 10 minutes. This is due to Steam's leaderboard system guidelines, not the game.

notes.title: Experience Points and permanent Upgrades
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45103258/e47c2d6bc2c1e5e70e371539fac3da62f6041301.png

In this update, a second currency has arrived in GraveyardGambit. You can use experience points to purchase permanent upgrades that persist even between individual rounds.

Earning Experience Points:

For each raid you successfully complete, you earn an experience point. Your experience points collected from raids are credited to you at the end of a round.

Upgrades:

There are 2 types of permanent upgrades: Levelable Upgrades and Mega Upgrades.

Levelable Upgrades:

You can upgrade levelable upgrades up to 7 times. These upgrades help you in every round.


 Speed Upgrade (Increases your running speed)
 Alarm Timer Upgrade (Increases the time of the alarm timer)
 Guard Speed Reduction (Reduces the running speed of guards)
 Bonus Gold (Gain bonus gold for successfully opening a grave)
 Stamina Regeneration (Your stamina bar refills faster)


Mega Upgrades:

You can only buy mega upgrades once. They are quite expensive but provide a mega upgrade.


 Beacon for Closed Exits (A beacon shows you which exits are locked)
 Always Loot (Every grave contains loot)
